title: The Last Day of Pompeii, Hour by Hour
notes: Register: clinical. The facts are horrifying enough and need no help. Clock times are approximate reconstructions: every on-screen time carries ≈ and never implies more precision than exists.
Energy follows the story. High for the setting, the date question and the science; calm as the afternoon darkens; still for every passage about the dead (s32, s39, s42, s44, s46).
Every image of Vesuvius erupting is from 1944 and carries a caption. The caption is mandatory: without it the 1944 photographs would read as AD 79.
No plaster casts and no human remains appear anywhere in this video. The casts are described over Fiorelli's tools (s53-s54). Do not add one; Commons has many and they will be tempting.

Nothing about the eruption's impact is generated: no eruption cloud, no collapsing roofs, no surge, no galleys, no Pliny at Stabiae or on the beach. Those beats use real ruins, the 1944 photographs, engraved diagrams with arrows, maps with tokens, or weather and empty places.
Those who stayed in Pompeii are never drawn. Cartoon figures appear only among the living who left, the Plinys at Misenum, and later centuries.
The charcoal inscription (s11) is NOT generated or drawn. It is a real artefact; the wall in the set stays blank and the date is set as type beside it.
Pliny's letters are paraphrased, never quoted.
LOW RESOLUTION: p12, p17 and p23 are small. Show them as cards at native size.
Every archival URL was resolved from the Commons API.
Guide object: the elder Pliny's sandals. 'He called for his shoes' (s03) returns as the final image (s61).

mother.desc: Pliny's mother Plinia, a Roman woman in a long stola and palla, simple vague face

pliny_e.desc: Pliny the Elder, a stout Roman admiral of middle age in a tunic and military cloak, simple vague face

fiorelli.desc: Giuseppe Fiorelli, a 19th-century archaeologist in a frock coat and waistcoat, seen mostly from behind, simple vague face

sets.misenum_villa: a Roman villa room at Misenum, a writing table, a mosaic floor, a stone doorway, afternoon light, a view of a wide bay through a window
sets.vesuvius_green: a green mountain above the Bay of Naples before any eruption, vineyards and farms on its slopes, a calm blue sky
sets.pompeii_town: a prosperous small Roman town by the sea at the foot of a green mountain, red roofs, temples, a calm sky
sets.ash_section: a cross-section of volcanic deposits in an excavation wall: distinct horizontal bands of pale pumice and darker grey ash
sets.scriptorium: a medieval scriptorium, a sloping writing desk, an inkwell, a window with soft light
sets.regio_v: a half-renovated Roman room, bare unpainted plaster wall, a builder's trestle, buckets, morning light
sets.pompeii_street: a paved Roman street in Pompeii, raised pavements, stepping stones, shopfronts and a fountain
sets.diagram_column: a vintage engraved cross-section diagram of a volcano and the sky above it, ground layers and slopes, unmarked
sets.map_bay: a large vintage parchment map of the Bay of Naples, the mountain at the head of the bay, coastlines in ink, an island offshore, unmarked
sets.misenum_harbour: a Roman naval harbour quay at Misenum, empty, stone bollards, the wide bay beyond
sets.stabiae_villa: a Roman villa courtyard at Stabiae at evening, a bath alcove, columns, a lamp, empty
sets.ash_field: a completely flat field of dense dark grey filling the whole frame, the faintest drifting grain, no subject, no horizon
sets.shore_storm: a heavy grey sea under an ash-dark sky, high waves breaking on an empty shore, no boats, no people
sets.misenum_road: a Roman road leading out of a seaside town at dawn, umbrella pines, a dark sky over the sea behind
sets.ash_landscape: a weak pale yellow sun through thick haze over a flat landscape blanketed in grey ash like deep snow, silent
sets.dig_1748: an 18th-century excavation: workmen's ladders and baskets in a deep cut through grey volcanic deposits, the tops of Roman walls appearing
sets.map_pompeii: a vintage engraved town plan of a Roman town with its walls, streets and blocks, unmarked
sets.naples_today: a modern city spread around a great bay below a volcano, dense rooftops, roads, evening light

props.cushion: a plump cushion tied with cord and a flat roof tile
